svg.title: Personal AI OS — the always-on layer of checks and automations
svg.desc: Every automatic check and guard, grouped by when it fires: on every write, on every retrieval, on ingest, when structure changes, during weekly maintenance, on-demand certification and vocabulary guarding, and always-on standing guards.
svg.text: Behind the scenes — the checks & guards that run while you work

g.text: preflight · search-before-create (dedupe) · validate (schema · IDs · naming · secrets · contracts)
four-outcome rule · journal entry · auto-checkpoint before risky changes
privacy filter (before ranking) · freshness-on-access (flags stale material)
preserve the original as a source · assess the nine effects · dedupe & link
dry-run → approval → checkpoint → apply → validate (refuses to continue past a failure)
import quarantines unmapped items to the Inbox · rollback restores any earlier checkpoint
health: broken links · duplicates · review-due · inbox age
freshness triage · drift checks · rebuild · doc-freshness · doc-check · doc-staleness
aios certify — governance/safety · idempotency · doc-truth · regression → ranked record
kill switch · protected objects (incl. no agent self-edits) · no personal data in the master
approval resets on edit · activation gates (tests + docs) · certification gates

svg.text: Most run for you automatically; certify and vocab are the two you invoke. Full reference: Flows/Automations Reference.md.
